About this item

  • LONGEST-LASTING TONE: Made with phosphor bronze wrap wire and our proprietary NANOWEB Technology, these strings deliver a rich, full-bodied tone for life, with a comfortable, smooth feel
  • LEADING PLAYERS: Whether on stage, in the studio or jamming at home, Elixir Strings are trusted by millions worldwide for their consistently brilliant tone, from our light strings to heavier gauges
  • STABLE & RESISTANT: Experience that fresh-out-the-box sound every time, thanks to our advanced technology that protects the entire string from sweat, corrosion, humidity and rust
  • MANUFACTURED IN THE USA: Every set of Elixir Strings is lab- and field-tested in our state-of-the-art facility. Engineered for less frequent string changes and more connecting with your music
  • CONTENTS: 1 x Elixir Strings, Acoustic Guitar Strings, Phosphor Bronze with NANOWEB Technology, Longest-Lasting Rich and Full Tone with Comfortable Feel, 6 String Set, Light 12-16-24-32-42-53

Product Description

Elixir Strings are trusted by players worldwide from home to stage for their longest-lasting tone. Our advanced NANOWEB Technology protects the entire string, even the gaps between the windings from debris buildup that deadens your tone. Your strings will sound and feel better for longer, saving you money and time without the hassle of endless string changes. These premium acoustic strings, crafted with phosphor bronze, deliver a full-bodied, rich tone and sparkling high-end clarity with a smooth and comfortable feel. So every note you play resonates with clarity and precision to match your passion.
